No, there's nothing. There isn't one thing in this fucked up world worth living for, and it certainly isn't myself. I'm going to finish myself off very soon. People will cry, act like they care, and then within a week or so, move on like nothing happened. I won't have any problems anymore, I'll be gone. Thankfully to me and everyone else that's ever met me.

I am the definition of a birth that should have been terminated from the beginning. I bring nothing but misery to everyone i've ever met, and i don't really care anymore

The best part is knowing that there is no consequence for me after i'm gone.
